question_text: Which College Football coaches will be out before Sep 1, 2026?
resolution_criteria:
If the head coach of the Auburn College Football team leaves, or announces they will leave, before Sep 1, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
Interim/temporary coaches are not included for purposes of this market.
